jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
dnata Travel Group, part of the Emirates Group, includes the brands of Gold Medal and Travelbag.



We are now recruiting for a Senior Software Engineer who will be working on all phases of software development, within a team of developers at our Leyland office. Working closely with product/programme management, infrastructure and architecture teams, to deliver high quality robust solutions within agreed timeframes.

  



The dnata Travel engineering team are responsible for the growth and evolution of in\-house developed travel platforms and integrate with a number of 3rd party platforms. These platforms are being developed and rolled out across multiple brands, departments and teams within the dnata Travel group.

  



You will be joining a smart, experienced, fast\-moving team working in an agile environment, who continue to explore new technologies, tools \& techniques to both grow the platforms and to service the growing needs of the business that the platforms supports.


**Hours:** Full\-time, 37\.5 per week


**Job Accountabilities**


* Undertake the development of high load, multi\-threaded, distributed, enterprise software systems to formal and informally provided design schematics.
* Deliver strong technical solutions with high quality and on time.
* Take ownership of assigned work items and drive to their successful conclusion.
* Provide clear and accurate updates on progress, status and risks.
* Provide representative and timely estimates for future work candidates.
* Maintain a good working knowledge of enterprise software development patterns, practices and methodologies.
* Maintain a good working knowledge of Microsoft web application .NET development technologies, including .NET, .NET Core, SQL Server 2012 and any subsequent versions.
* Stay up to date with technology developments and techniques that provide commercial advantage.
* To work with all members of the Development Team to promote a good team working environment where open communication is invited.
* Respond to live issues raised throughout the business.
* Liaise with the testing and infrastructure teams on technical and support issues.
* Communicate complex technical solutions in a clear and concise manner to members of the development team and IT department.
* Work to continually improve the development team's processes and methodologies.
* Provide On Call support to the business

  


**To be considered for this role, we need you to have the following skills, experience and qualifications:**


* A background in delivering web sites / services using .NET technology environment.
* Knowledge of principles and concepts and practical experience of a wide range of technology solutions.
* A strong track record of software delivery.
* Experience of working on multi\-tier, high volume, transactional systems and a thorough understanding of the related challenges and how to navigate them.
* Broad knowledge of key technology theories and architectures (e.g. data structures, algorithms, design patterns, application architectures, technologies and solution design).
* Experience of developing and supporting API’s and micro services supplying a service to both internal and external customers.
* Experience of software development within the travel industry.

  


**For more information, please click on the job description below**

  



Our bright, modern office in Leyland is just 10 minutes from junctions 28 \& 29 of the M6\. We have some fantastic benefits, making us a great place to work:


* Travel discounts – we have a dedicated Staff Travel Team to help you plan your next adventure
* 25 days annual leave, increasing to 28 days after 5 full years of service (\+ bank holidays)
* Additional annual leave purchase scheme
* Company pension scheme
* Life assurance
* Low\-cost health care for you and your family
* Employee Assistance programme
* Mental Health First Aiders
* Ongoing development – we have an in\-house People Development Team
* Industry/social events – including supplier events, office socials \& parties and pop\-up shops
* Cycle to work scheme
* Reward \& recognition programme
* Belong programme \- Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that play a crucial role in implementing our DEI strategy
* Volunteer days – one day’s paid leave each year to volunteer with a registered charity
* dnata4good – supporting the local communities we work, live and thrive in
* Refer a friend scheme
* Free eye care tests

### **Job description**


Är du en erfaren Mjukvaruutvecklare inom Fullstack eller Backend som är redo för nya utmaningar? Vi letar efter dig som är redo att kliva ombord på vår tillväxtresa i ett nytt konsultbolag inom system\- och mjukvaruutveckling. Välkommen till ett företag där vi bygger framtidens lösningar.


**Om oss**


Vi är inte som alla andra. Vi är Sigma Industry East North – en del av en prisbelönt koncern med hjärtat på rätt ställe och siktet inställt på både roligheter och kvalitet. Vi fortsätter att bygga ett helt nytt bolag med säte i Liljeholmen, där fokus är mjukvara och Embedded\-system. Med oss får du möjligheten att vara med och bygga upp ett nytt företag från grunden, med allt vad det innebär av spännande utmaningar och möjligheter.


### **Basic qualifications**


Vi söker dig som har en konsultbakgrund inom mjukvaruutveckling, och som har en stark vilja och ett driv att utveckla både dig själv och andra, men framför allt leverera inom ditt gebit. Du är van vid att arbeta i agila projektmiljöer och har erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera digitala lösningar i olika branscher. Du är kommunikativ, lösningsorienterad och trivs i en roll där du får kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med praktiskt ingenjörsarbete.


### **Preferred additional skills, personal traits and experience**


**Kompetenskrav:**


* Minst 7 års arbetslivserfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och programmering:
	+ Back\-end i något av språken Java, C\# .Net, Python, Go, Typesscript eller Node.js/Next.js
	+ Front\-end i språk och ramverk som Javascript, React,SpringBoot, Angular och Vue
* Erfarenhet av agila metoder (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)
* Erfarenhet av databaser (SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Mongo DB)
* Molnerfarenhet (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Erfarenhet av Deployment och DevOps (exempelvis Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Terraform)
* Du använder AI dagligen i ditt arbete (Claude Code, Cursor etc.)
* Smidig i att balansera smart teknik med användarvänliga gränssnitt
* Svenska och engelska obehindrat både i tal och skrift.
* Svenskt medborgarskap.

**Meriterande:**


* Tidigare erfarenhet av att vara konsult och varit i flera branscher
* Relevanta utbildningar och/eller certifieringar inom området
* Erfarenhet av mjukvarutestning och testautomatisering

### **We offer**


Här får du vara med och bygga upp något från grunden i en arbetsmiljö med högt i tak, mycket skratt och ständig utveckling. Vi erbjuder även ett gäng fantastiska konsultkollegor som är lika taggade som du, korta beslutsvägar, och spännande projekt som sträcker sig över flera olika branscher – från Fordon, Försvar och Tillverkning till Energi, Medtech, Telekom, Retail och IT.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Miért az SMP?
  

  

Nagy létszámú nemzetközi csapatunk négy kontinensen, szakismerettel és készséggel dolgozik közös célunkon, hogy minőségi alkatrészeket készítsünk prémium kategóriás autókhoz.
  

  

A kecskeméti SMP gyár a Samvardhana Motherson Group fontos részeként működik, amely a világ 26 legnagyobb autóipari beszállítója közé tartozik.
  

  

Munkatársaink csapatban dolgoznak, támogatják egymást és mindig készek arra, hogy valami újat tanuljanak.
  

  

Büszkék vagyunk arra, hogy munkánk eredménye részese a világ piacvezető autómárkáinak!
  

  

Folyamatosan fejlesztjük munkafolyamatainkat és törekszünk termékeink tökéletesítésére.
  

  

Ehhez szükségünk van Rád, hiszen tehetséged jelentős tovább lépést biztosít számunkra is!
  

  

Versenyképes juttatási csomagot kínálunk, mely felelősségteljes, önálló munkával párosul. Az autóipar világa érdekes és kihívásokkal teli, mindemellett családias kultúra jellemzi vállalatunkat. Fejlődési és továbblépési lehetőséget biztosítunk Számodra, egy gyorsan növekvő globális vállalatnál.
  
**Full Stack Developer**
========================


A Motherson Group a világ 21\. legnagyobb és leggyorsabban növekvő globális autóipari cégcsoportja, amely több további iparágat, például járműipart, repülőgépipart, orvostudományt, informatikát és logisztikát szolgál ki, és több mint 135 000 alkalmazottal rendelkezik Világszerte 41 országban vagyunk jelen. Az elnök európai irodája (COE) vállalati funkciókkal és szolgáltatásokkal támogatja és koordinálja működési egységeinket, K \+ F központjainkat és képviseleteinket Európa szerte. Gyors növekedésünk miatt folyamatosan keresünk tehetséges új kollégákat, hogy részeseivé váljanak csapatunknak.
### **Feladatok:**


* Own assigned applications, modules, or projects end to end, including planning, estimation, design, development, testing,
* release, and post\-go\-live support.
* Develop responsive, maintainable, and user\-friendly web interfaces using Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS.
* Design and develop secure backend services and REST APIs using C\#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and Entity
* Framework Core or Dapper.
* Design relational data models and write efficient T\-SQL, stored procedures, functions, views, and database objects in
* Microsoft SQL Server.
* Diagnose and resolve performance issues across the frontend, API, and database layers, including query optimization,
* indexing, and root\-cause analysis.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and
* trade\-offs to stakeholders.
* Integrate applications with enterprise systems and third\-party services using APIs, scheduled jobs, files, or messaging
* interfaces.
* Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and maintain clean, reusable, secure, and well\-documented
* code.
* Use Git\-based source control and support build, release, and CI/CD processes through tools such as Azure DevOps or
* equivalent platforms.
* Provide production support for business\-critical applications, document recurring issues, and implement permanent
* corrective actions.

### **Elvárások:**


* Minimum 5 years of professional full stack software development experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Angular and TypeScript in production applications.
* Strong hands\-on experience with C\#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Web API, and object\-oriented programming.
* Advanced Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL skills, including schema design, complex joins, stored procedures, indexing,
* execution plans, and performance tuning.
* Demonstrated experience independently delivering at least one substantial application or project from requirements to
* production support.
* Solid understanding of RESTful API design, authentication and authorization, error handling, logging, and secure coding
* practices.
* Experience with Git, branching and pull\-request workflows, debugging, code review, and standard software development
* lifecycle practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full technology stack and work effectively with limited supervision.
* Good written and spoken English, with the ability to work directly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Előny:**


* Experience with manufacturing systems, MES, ERP, WMS, traceability, production reporting, or other business\-critical
* enterprise applications.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, cloud services, microservices, or messaging technologies.
* Experience with SSRS, Power BI, background services, scheduled jobs, or enterprise system integrations.
* Working knowledge of software architecture principles, SOLID, design patterns, automated testing, OWASP guidance, and
* Agile delivery.
* Experience supporting high\-availability production systems and conducting structured incident investigation and root\-cause
* analysis.

### **Amit kínálunk:**


* Opportunity to work across the complete solution lifecycle and influence technical decisions.
* Collaboration with operational, business, and IT stakeholders in an enterprise environment.

### **Munkavégzés helye:**


Kecskemét

jobs.title: Consulting Engineer
jobs.description:
MongoDB Professional Services (PS) works with customers of all shapes and sizes, in all verticals, from tier-1 banks to small web startups, on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top notch people in the business, networks with industry leaders, and sees new places - all in a day’s work!

MongoDB consulting exists to support the development of our customers’ vision, accelerate customers’ time to value, and drive a multitude of customer adoption scenarios - from building new solutions to modernizing legacy applications or migrating to cloud. Our consulting solutions ensure that organizations get the best out of MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Berlin for our hybrid working model.

Our ideal candidate will have

2+ years of software development/consulting/support experience, preferably in a number of distinct industries/verticals
Familiarity with enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations
Competence in at least one of the following languages (in no particular order): Java, C++, C#, Python, Node.js (JavaScript), Ruby, Perl, Scala, Go
Experience with databases such as MongoDB, Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL
Familiarity with Linux diagnostics and tuning; Windows tuning knowledge is a plus
Excellent analytical, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills
High motivation for a role that combines deep technical and customer-management dimensions
Confidence speaking and presenting in a customer setting
Fluency in both English and German languages.

Position Expectations

As a core member of the MongoDB PS team, you will:

Contribute to customer implementations at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: portfolio assessment, application planning and design, deployment architectures, development and build, integration and release configuration, system testing, production operations, application optimization, and best practices adoption
Deliver customer classroom-based training to architect, developer and operations roles
Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising fellow consulting engineers, project managers and account teams
Cultivate your individual MongoDB reputation as a trusted advisor to guide MongoDB and our customers into the future
Partner with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap
Have the ability to travel up to 20% in normal circumstances and when clients are expressing preference to meet in person

Success Measures

As a Consulting Engineer you will be successful in this role when you can execute the following:

Become a field specialist in “everything MongoDB”
Communicate sophisticated technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences
Ensure your client’s success with their MongoDB endeavors
Maintain required level of billable utilization
Influence MongoDB product development by contributing experience from the field
Communicate the product roadmap to external clients
Constantly work on improving yourself, our products and our team

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

nShift
is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About You

We are seeking a dynamic and accomplished .NET Developer to join our talented Portal team. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of technical expertise in modern .NET development, frontend skills, and a passion for working with cutting-edge AI technology. As a key player in our organization, you should have a proven track record of delivering high-quality software, building scalable systems, and continuously learning new technologies.

Purpose of role

In the Portal, we're building innovative User Management, Identity Provider, SCIM solutions. This is an opportunity to contribute to an active, growing AI platform and expand its capabilities through practical, hands-on development.

We are looking for a practical, hands-on developer who will help us build, improve, and extend the chat system by implementing real features using established libraries and modern best practices.

No prior AI/LLM experience required
- we're looking for strong software engineers who are excited to learn and work with cutting-edge AI technology. If you have solid engineering fundamentals and curiosity about AI, we'll help you develop the AI-specific skills.

Your role includes:

Building and maintaining both backend (.NET) and frontend (VUE/React/TypeScript) components
Implementing AI agent features and LLM integrations using established frameworks
Developing real-time streaming conversation systems
Creating document ingestion and processing pipelines
Contributing to technical decisions and architectural improvements
Collaborating with Product Managers and the engineering team to deliver high-quality features

What You'll Be Doing

Technology

Build and maintain scalable, secure, and resilient .NET code
Develop responsive React applications with TypeScript and modern frontend practices
Integrate with multiple LLM providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock)
Implement real-time streaming systems using WebSocket/SSE
Work with vector databases and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns
Ensure code quality through testing, type hints, and code reviews
Keep the technology stack up to date and follow best practices

Process

Follow established development processes and advocate for continuous improvement
Write clean, well-documented code with comprehensive tests
Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions
Use modern development tools and practices (Git, Docker, CI/CD)
Challenge yourself and the team to enhance working methods
Contribute to technical documentation and internal education

Collaboration

Work closely with other developers, product managers, and stakeholders
Participate in planning and architectural discussions
Share knowledge and mentor team members on technical topics
Communicate effectively in English (written and spoken)
Take ownership of features from design to deployment

What You Will Bring

For the role of Software Engineer in our Portal team at nShift, we are seeking candidates who embody the following characteristics:

Technical Proficiency

Problem-Solving Ability
: You have strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex systems and find elegant solutions.

Learning Mindset
: Genuine curiosity about AI/ML and eagerness to learn new technologies. You are comfortable reading documentation and learning new frameworks quickly.

Quality Focus
: You maintain high standards in code quality, testing, and software craftsmanship. You understand the importance of writing maintainable, well-tested code.

Effective Communication

Ownership Mindset
: You take responsibility for your work, follow through on commitments, and care about delivering value to users.
